about: Every place the mod touches the game. Each row is one read or write. Field names come from a third-party SF6 Lua script (rkaganda/SF6_replay_capture); none of them are proven until the probe runs in the real game.

rows.purpose: Detect a new round so per-round state resets
Detect that the match simulation advanced one tick (render frames and sim ticks differ)
Read health to find damage taken and Rage threshold; write it to add bonus damage and chip damage
rows.source: SF6_replay_capture: cPlayer[i].vital_new (read only there; writing is unproven)

rows.purpose: Detect the moment a fighter starts blocking (blockstun begins) for Heat chip damage
Research only: what SF6 tracks during air combos, to see whether juggle scaling can be changed
Read the keyboard keys that trigger Heat (REFramework gives raw keys only, no gamepad)
